decisions.reason: As a recently launched product close to the core offer and already given its own webpage, it fits the firm's modular formwork business and there is little reason yet to reverse a visible commitment in a growing market.

This automation-oriented product builds directly on the firm's established systems and supports the stated strategic push toward automation, so management is likely to continue backing it despite its still recent market introduction.

Although it was only mentioned rather than prominently featured, it is still near the firm's existing formwork line and the firm has little incentive to admit failure so soon without clear evidence of lasting weak demand.

The product is close to the established offer and was presented on its own page, indicating visible commitment that a medium-sized German machinery firm with in-house R&D would be reluctant to unwind after only a short time.

Its dedicated webpage and strong fit with the firm's existing magnetic formwork portfolio make withdrawal unlikely, especially while the firm is expanding and can attribute any early underperformance to rollout effects.

This product has the weakest public commitment among the set because it was only mentioned on the website, but its closeness to the core business and the absence of clear negative results still favor keeping it for now.
